subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI-billed `code_execution` and `x_search` be hidden whenever active-model provider metadata is missing or non-xAI, or should intentional cross-provider use remain available behind an explicit opt-in?
rationale: The fail-closed behavior matches the sensitive-tool guidance and fixes the reported billing boundary, but it changes existing unknown-provider contexts from credential-based exposure to hidden tools.

options.title: Accept fail-closed default
options.body: Approve hiding xAI-billed tools unless the active provider is positively `xai`, then require real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve deliberate unknown-provider or cross-provider use through a documented, tested opt-in path before changing the default.

options.title: Pause for broader policy
options.body: Hold this PR while the canonical issue settles billed-tool consent, billing visibility, and provider-owned tool policy together.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed default
recommendation.body: Approve hiding xAI-billed tools unless the active provider is positively `xai`, then require real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the active-model context and the current lazy xAI tool factory shape that define the compatibility boundary for this decision.
